Small Changes Can Have A Big Impact
More TonMiles tighten the tanker market They say that the only constant in the tanker market is change and we have seen that again in 2025. After comparing the top 20 Dirty Trade Routes of 2025 with those of the previous year, we can see a number of small changes that are having an impact on global TonMile demand.
